newsitem.title: USA: Radiant Systems to acquire ReMACS.
newsitem.headline: Radiant Systems to acquire ReMACS.

text.p: Radiant Systems Inc on Friday said it has entered into a merger with Restaurant Management and Control Systems Inc, or ReMACS, of Pleasanton, Calif.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
ReMACS is a provider of back office and corporate management systems to the food service industry. The transaction is expected to close by May 28, 1997.
Radiant's Quick Service Restaurant business will be combined with ReMACS into Radiant Hospitality Systems, a new operating division of Radiant Systems Inc, the company said.
